questions.solution_text:
1. **Identify the limits $x=a$ and $x=b$**
$9-x^{2}=0$
$x=-3,\ 3$
2. **Write $y^{2}$ in terms of $x$, expanding or simplifying first**
$y^{2}=81-18x^{2}+x^{4}$
3. **Evaluate $V=\pi\int_{a}^{b}y^{2}\,dx$**
$V=\pi\int_{-3}^{3}\left(81-18x^{2}+x^{4}\right)dx$
$= \pi\left[81x-6x^{3}+\dfrac{x^{5}}{5}\right]_{-3}^{3}$
$= 2\pi\left(243-162+\dfrac{243}{5}\right)$
$= \dfrac{1296\pi}{5}\ \text{units}^{3}$

questions.solution_text:
$V=\pi\int_{0}^{k}\left(\sqrt{x}\right)^{2}dx$
$= \pi\int_{0}^{k}x\,dx$
$= \pi\left[\dfrac{x^{2}}{2}\right]_{0}^{k}$
$= \dfrac{\pi k^{2}}{2}$
Setting this equal to the given volume:
$\dfrac{\pi k^{2}}{2}=18\pi$
$k^{2}=36$
$k=6$
